subject: Post-call: Multilingual model fit & evals — EU & APAC next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Leblanc <sophie.leblanc@globexretail.eu>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:14:00+01:00
Subject: Post-call: Multilingual model fit & evals — EU & APAC next steps

Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for taking the time to demo your personalization use cases this morning — great context on localized product descriptions and customer Q&A volumes by country. Quick recap + recommended next steps from our side: 

1) Recap of needs:
- High-quality generation in FR/DE/ES for product descriptions (short form, 40–120 chars)
- Customer support answers in EN/FR/JA with strict guardrails on hallucination
- Latency SLO: 150–300ms p50 for synchronous lookups; throughput: ~400 reqs/sec during peak

2) Preliminary model fit / recommendations:
- Candidate model families: RedM-7B-MLQ (quantized) for inference efficiency; OpenLLaMA-13B-multilingual for higher-quality long-form fallbacks
- For support QA where hallucination risk is higher, we recommend RedM-13B-LLM with context grounding and KB retrieval layer

3) Evals we ran (attached):
- eval_results_eu_v1.csv: precision/recall/ROUGE for FR/DE/ES prompt-set v2
- prompt_set_fr_de_es_v2.md: the exact prompts & reference answers we used
- multilingual-benchmarks-2026.pdf: summary dashboard and latency/cost estimates

4) Quality/regression concerns:
- Observed slight degradation on German compound handling when switching to the 7B quantized profile (see row DE_compound in CSV). We recommend a guided prompt augmentation + a small synthetic augmentation to the eval set before committing to quantized rollout.

5) Proposed next steps:
- Redwood runs 48-hour localized evals against your 1k sample subset for FR/DE/ES + Japanese (APAC) if you can provide the sample (we can also sample from production logs with a privacy-safe filter)
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up to review results and agree on canary thresholds (I propose Tue 11/24 or Wed 11/25 morning CET)
- If results look good, we scope a 4-week POC with Dedicated capacity + rollback policy

Action items for Sophie: please confirm which 1k samples you want us to use (FR/DE/ES only, or include EN/JA), and whether we should pull from Prod logs or your curated test set.

Attached: eval_results_eu_v1.csv, prompt_set_fr_de_es_v2.md, multilingual-benchmarks-2026.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

Hi Marissa — thanks for the detailed summary and attachments. Quick answers: 

- We'll share a curated set of 1k FR/DE/ES product descriptions (sanitized) from our test bucket by EOD Monday (11/23). Please do NOT pull from Prod logs for this initial eval.
- We definitely want Japanese included later — can you run a separate APAC pass once the EU results look good?

Questions from our localization team: 
- For the DE compound issue, can you share a couple of example prompts/references where the 7B quantized model failed? That will help our translators create targeted synthetic augmentations.
- Cost/latency: can you confirm the p50/p95 latency estimates for the RedM-7B-MLQ quantized profile in Dedicated? Also an estimate of token cost per 1k requests.

We're happy to do Tue 11/24 09:30 CET for a 30-min follow-up. Sending calendar now.

Thanks,
Sophie
Director, Localization Programs
Globex Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Leblanc <sophie.leblanc@globexretail.eu>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jiro Tanaka <jiro.tanaka@aureliabank.jp>
Date: 2026-11-23T00:22:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Multilingual model fit & evals — EU & APAC next steps

Hi Sophie — great, appreciate the quick turnaround on samples. Answers inline: 

- Example failures: see prompt_set_fr_de_es_v2.md (section "DE edge cases") — two examples included, copied below for convenience:

> Prompt: "Titel: wasserdichte winterjacke für herren; Bullet: Material: polyamid; Beschreibung: kurz"
> Reference: "Kurz geschnittene, wasserfeste Winterjacke für Herren mit isolierender Füllung"
> RedM-7B-MLQ output: "Kurze Winterjacke, wasserfest, Herren, mit Isolierung" (loses compound cohesion leading to unnatural ordering)

- Latency/cost: on Dedicated with RedM-7B-MLQ we estimate p50=110–160ms, p95=320–420ms depending on sequence length and batching. Token cost approx $0.85 per 1k tokens for the quantized runtime in Dedicated (this is an estimate — exact quote depends on committed throughput). We'll provide a cost table in the follow-up deck.

Next steps from Redwood: 
- We will spin up the EU localized eval (FR/DE/ES) using your curated set as soon as you upload the bundle to the Drive link you mentioned; I'll notify once the job starts and share the ephemeral dashboard link.
- Rishi (cc) will own the quantized rollout playbook and validation checks. Neha will coordinate the canary thresholds and QA gating.

Confirmed: Tue 11/24 09:30 CET for 30 minutes. I accepted the calendar invite.

If you want, we can also run a short synthetic augmentation pass for DE (low effort) before the main eval — Rishi, can you confirm feasibility?

Best,
Marissa
